t: A sewing activity where students stitch a felt toy with a lighted circuit.
steps: Find Light-Up Plush Pals on TeachEngineering and read the lesson.
Gather a ProtoSnap LilyPad E-Sewing Kit for each group.
Gather conductive thread, a 3V coin cell, felt, needles, and hot glue.
Print the Light-Up Plush Pals template.
Build one plush yourself before class.
Plan for hot glue use and set safety rules for needles.
Split the 2 hours 30 minutes across days as needed.
